card: S09/S10 ViT QK static (sQ/sK per head)
gpu_lock: NOT_TOUCHED - @NR_GPU_WORKSPACE@/artifacts/parallel-port-20261013/GPU.lock was never opened, created or probed
policy: the master executor owns scheduling and the single GPU queue. This file only declares what must run, in what order, and what would falsify the candidate. No job here may be started by this card.

control.purpose: same 8 BUFFER + 48 BIND edits, deployed SPV kept; the packs keep the original 128 B prefix, so this run MUST be numerically identical to combo-34189. It proves the 128->384 resize and the file swap are inert before any conclusion about the static scales is drawn.

gpu_jobs.role: plumbing control (1 frame). Runs BEFORE GPU-01 and is a hard precondition for it.
gpu_jobs.compare: network output byte-identical to combo-34189 on the same frame; and the 8 dumped ViT T buffers identical
gpu_jobs.gate: ANY difference falsifies the plan edit itself (a 128->384 BIND resize or a file re-point changed something). Stop, do not run GPU-01.

gpu_jobs.role: LOCAL numeric gate for the static sQ/sK (1 frame). This is the first real measurement.
preconditions: census re-run on the deployed copy of the SPV: OpAtomicUMax count == 1 and its destination is shVMax (a count of 3 means the old module was shipped; 0 means sV was accidentally closed too)
the 8 PACK files on disk still match the sha256 in tools/s09-qk-static-study.json
a debug-store arm that can dump vit_blockNN_T (Context) per block is available for both plans
compare: per block: ViT attention T (Context buffer) relL2 vs the SAME buffer of combo-34189 on the same frame; CPU prediction is x1.03..x1.12 of the deployed local error, i.e. a small, uniform increment, no block singled out
per block: T relL2 vs the CPU reference in tools/s09-qk-static-study.json (frame F1, arm static_qk) - the GPU must agree with the CPU to roughly f16 level
worst single head: report it; the CPU worst is well below 1e-2
gpu_jobs.gate: if the GPU-vs-CPU disagreement exceeds 2x, stop: that is an implementation bug, not quantisation. If a block moves by more than ~5x the CPU prediction, the pack for that block is suspect (index/order).

gpu_jobs.role: 3-frame whole-network arm (34189, 41444, 43654). Report only; NOT a quality pass.
gpu_jobs.run: same replay for the three frames
compare: final network output PSNR vs the captured FP16 output, per frame and vs the 34189 baseline
worst frame and the per-frame direction, so a single lucky frame cannot be selected post hoc
report whether the F2/F3 clip fractions that the CPU study predicts (0.14..0.28% of Q/K codes) show up as any visible outlier
gpu_jobs.gate: quality_accepted stays false regardless of the dB number. A PSNR drop larger than the deployed candidate's own known spread is a blocker for GPU-03, not a pass.

gpu_jobs.role: 24-frame accumulation of the first accepted candidate (only after GPU-01/02).
gpu_jobs.run: the existing 24-frame measurement path (measure_static_24.py equivalent), mean PSNR, worst frame, per-frame direction, RGB error, history behaviour
gpu_jobs.gate: a mean dB number here is NOT a quality pass; quality_accepted stays false

cpu_jobs_remaining.goal: reconstruct Q/K/V for one Swin c64 block and one split16 l2 block from the existing FP16 Y dumps + the FP16 WQKV pack, and validate the CPU reference against dump_swin_<b>_T / dump_split16_b<nn>_T
cpu_jobs_remaining.why: the other 60 attention modules can only be closed after this; the ViT measurement does not transfer without it
cpu_jobs_remaining.accept: CPU context vs the T dump relL2 <= 1e-3 on all heads of the block
cpu_jobs_remaining.blocked_on: Y dump layout and WQKV half layout must be proven elementwise first (a wrong layout produces a plausible but meaningless reference)

cpu_jobs_remaining.goal: per-family QKV A-side (sX/sY) amax calibration for c64/c128/c256
cpu_jobs_remaining.accept: clip_frac == 0 on the two evaluation frames and a context relL2 increment <= 10% of the dynamic baseline

any job on a plan that binds the capture inputs for production
any U8xS8 job (no real operand support evidence exists; STATIC-DESIGN.md 3)
any job that closes sP without changing the P representation (rejected, STATIC-DESIGN.md 2)
any job that claims 'whole-network pure static' from these two closed sites
